check_box.label: Enable sun/moon god rays
check_box.tool_tip: If checked, renders raymarched sun/moon light shafts through shadowed geometry. Requires Shadows to be enabled above None in the graphics preferences. Works on macOS.
check_box.name: render_volumetric_lighting

slider.label: Scatter albedo
slider.name: render_volumetric_lighting_albedo
slider.tool_tip: Single-scattering albedo fraction for volumetric sun and moon light shafts. Higher values scatter more of the incident light toward the camera. Range: 0.00 to 1.00. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Scatter density
slider.name: render_volumetric_lighting_density
slider.tool_tip: Density of the scattering medium for sun/moon volumetric lighting. Higher values shorten visible shafts, suppress distant anti-solar rays, and (together with albedo) increase overall scatter brightness. Range: 0.000 to 0.250. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Sky gradient (sun)
slider.name: render_volumetric_lighting_sun_asymmetry
slider.tool_tip: Henyey-Greenstein scattering asymmetry (g) while the sun is up. Higher values sharpen the sky's brightness gradient around the sun (brighter near it, darker away from it); lower values look flatter/more uniform. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Sky gradient (moon)
slider.name: render_volumetric_lighting_asymmetry
slider.tool_tip: Henyey-Greenstein scattering asymmetry (g) while the moon is up. Higher values sharpen the sky's brightness gradient around the moon (brighter near it, darker away from it); lower values look flatter/more uniform. Changes are applied live.

check_box.label: High quality rays (full resolution)
check_box.tool_tip: Uses full-resolution raymarching with 32 samples instead of half resolution with 16 samples. Significantly increases GPU cost. Changes are applied live.
check_box.name: render_volumetric_lighting_high_quality

spinner.name: render_volumetric_lighting_debug
spinner.tool_tip: 0: normal. Directional-only: 1: raw sun/moon scatter. 2: mean occlusion. 3: mean visibility. 4: reconstructed view-space position. 5: ray distance. 6: amplified reverse device-depth proximity. 7: fixed off-center inverse-projection magnitude sanity check; green is finite/nonzero, black is near-zero, and magenta is NaN/Inf. Local-only: 8: raw local-light scatter. 9: fraction of selected local-light volumes intersecting each visible ray. 10: raw 4x4 cumulative transparency atlas (near to far, left-to-right along each row, starting at the bottom and progressing upward). 11: same atlas layout, showing raw scene transmittance T (white/1.0 = no attenuation, black/0.0 = fully attenuated) instead of scatter color. All non-zero modes replace the screen outright.

check_box.label: Include local lights (unshadowed)
check_box.tool_tip: Adds bounded fog glow from nearby point and spot lights. Local lights are not shadowed and can leak through walls. Disabled by default.
check_box.name: render_volumetric_local_lights

slider.label: Local intensity
slider.name: render_volumetric_local_lights_intensity
slider.tool_tip: Controls only the unshadowed fog contribution from nearby local lights.

spinner.name: render_volumetric_local_lights_max_count
spinner.tool_tip: Caps the highest-scored nearby lights evaluated per pixel. Lower this if local volumetrics cost too much GPU time.

button.name: reset_volumetric_albedo
button.tool_tip: Reset scatter albedo to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_density
button.tool_tip: Reset scatter density to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_sun_asymmetry
button.tool_tip: Reset sun sky gradient to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_moon_asymmetry
button.tool_tip: Reset moon sky gradient to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_high_quality
button.tool_tip: Reset high quality rays to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_debug
button.tool_tip: Reset debug mode to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_local_intensity
button.tool_tip: Reset local intensity to its default value

button.name: reset_volumetric_local_max_count
button.tool_tip: Reset maximum local lights to its default value
